title: Chalcogen-Rich Lanthanide Clusters with Fluorinated Thiolate Ligands

material_class.structural_family: square Yb4 array with a central μ4-Se2- and four edge-bridging μ2-(SeSe) ligands

synthesis.procedure: Under ultrapure nitrogen (drybox/Schlenk), Yb and Hg(SC6F5)2 were combined in THF and stirred until all Yb was consumed (1 h). The red solution was filtered into a THF solution of (THF)nYb(SeC6H5)3. The dark red mixture, containing some red precipitate, was stirred for 12 h, then elemental Se was added. The dark red solution was filtered, concentrated in vacuo to 40 mL, and layered with hexane to give dark red crystals of 1 that continuously darken and appear to lose solvent at 150 °C and again at 255 °C.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature (not otherwise specified); crystals darken/lose solvent at 150 °C and 255 °C
synthesis.time: Yb consumption 1 h; then 12 h before Se addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: drybox or Schlenk techniques under ultrapure nitrogen
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filter; concentrate in vacuo to 40 mL; layer with hexane (60 mL) to give dark red crystals

properties.summary: Dark red crystals. Well-defined UV/vis absorptions in THF assigned as E-to-Yb charge-transfer excitations (377, 448, and 520 nm), richer than the sulfur analogue and contrasting with the visibly transparent Tm analogue 2.

source_locations.location: Experimental UV/vis of 1; Results absorption spectra paragraph

material_class.structural_family: square Ln4 chalcogen-rich cluster analogous to 1 (unit cell reported; full structure not deposited in supplied CCDC rows)

synthesis.procedure: Under ultrapure nitrogen, Tm and Hg(SC6F5)2 were combined in THF and stirred until all Tm was consumed (1.5 h). The colorless solution was filtered into a light green THF solution of (THF)3Tm(SeC6H5)3. After 12 h elemental Se was added. The dark brown/green solution was filtered, reduced to 40 mL under vacuum, and layered with hexane to give orange crystals (the experimental paragraph labels the crystals as 3, but the heading and analysis correspond to Tm compound 2).
synthesis.temperature: not specified for reaction; crystals begin to darken at 85 °C and are brown by 200 °C
synthesis.time: Tm consumption 1.5 h; 12 h before Se addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: drybox or Schlenk techniques under ultrapure nitrogen
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filter; reduce volume to 40 mL under vacuum; layer with hexane (60 mL) to give orange crystals

properties.summary: Orange crystals of the redox-inactive Tm analogue are described as visibly transparent relative to the Yb clusters; only weak f–f transitions were resolved in the UV/vis spectrum.

measurements.name: UV/vis f-f transitions
measurements.conditions: THF; only weak f-f transitions resolved

source_locations.location: Experimental UV/vis of 2; Results comparison with Yb CT bands

material_class.structural_family: square Yb4 array with a central μ4-S2- and four edge-bridging μ2-(SS) ligands

synthesis.procedure: Under ultrapure nitrogen, Yb and Hg(SC6F5)2 were combined in THF and stirred until all Yb was consumed (1 h). The red solution was filtered into a THF solution of (THF)3Yb(SC6H5)3 and stirred for 3 h before elemental S was added. The dark red solution (ca. 60 mL) was filtered, concentrated in vacuo to 40 mL, and layered with hexane to give red crystals that turn brown by 150 °C. The compound is soluble in toluene (70 mg of 3 in 2 mL toluene) with no significant change in the visible spectrum.
synthesis.temperature: not specified for reaction; crystals turn brown by 150 °C
synthesis.time: Yb consumption 1 h; then 3 h before S addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: drybox or Schlenk techniques under ultrapure nitrogen
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filter; concentrate in vacuo to 40 mL; layer with hexane (60 mL) to give red crystals

properties.summary: Red crystals. Diagnostic E-to-Yb charge-transfer absorptions at 415 and 455 nm in THF that do not shift dramatically (417, 454 nm) in toluene.

measurements.name: UV/vis absorption maxima
measurements.conditions: toluene; no significant change versus THF

source_locations.location: Experimental UV/vis of 3; Results absorption spectra paragraph
